blurb: Guests board the classic motor yacht Brigadoon for intimate cruises around Baltimore's Inner Harbor. Cruises include sightseeing of landmarks like the Domino Sugar Building, historic ships, Fort McHenry, and the working port. Special event cruises offer views of the Parade of Sail, Tall Ships, and Blue Angels airshow performances.

Late Arrival Please make every effort to arrival at the time indicated for your charter.
Late Arrival - Private Charters Private charters start at the time scheduled.
Arrivals more than 1 hour late are considered no-shows and the charter is canceled without refund.
